description:
A command line interface for the Nitrokey FIDO2, Nitrokey Start, Nitrokey 3 and NetHSM.


This release adds support for NethHSM v5 and the `fido2 provision-credential` command, updates the minimum Python version to 3.11 and fixes some bugs.

Note that the default branch for this repository is now `main`. The `master` branch will be deleted soon.

## What's Changed
• PIV factory-reset：show proper error message when the PIN isn't locked by @sosthene-nitrokey in https://github.com/Nitrokey/pynitrokey/pull/771
• Windows versioninfo and version format by @mmerklinger in https://github.com/Nitrokey/pynitrokey/pull/774
• pre-registration for entra by @AdityaMitra5102 in https://github.com/Nitrokey/pynitrokey/pull/783
• nethsm generate-key：Fix interactive mechanism selection by @robin-nitrokey in https://github.com/Nitrokey/pynitrokey/pull/784
• PIV import and PUK fixes by @ABuljko in https://github.com/Nitrokey/pynitrokey/pull/766
• fido2：plug some resource leaks in the client by @kevans91 in https://github.com/Nitrokey/pynitrokey/pull/781
• Add NetHSM features from Nethsm v3.0.0rc by @AdityaMitra5102 in https://github.com/Nitrokey/pynitrokey/pull/787
• Entra provision by @AdityaMitra5102 in https://github.com/Nitrokey/pynitrokey/pull/789
• Update clustering features for NetHSM v5.0 and release v0.13.0rc1 by @robin-nitrokey in https://github.com/Nitrokey/pynitrokey/pull/788
• Release v0.13.0 by @robin-nitrokey in https://github.com/Nitrokey/pynitrokey/pull/793

## New Contributors
• @AdityaMitra5102 made their first contribution in https://github.com/Nitrokey/pynitrokey/pull/783
• @ABuljko made their first contribution in https://github.com/Nitrokey/pynitrokey/pull/766
• @kevans91 made their first contribution in https://github.com/Nitrokey/pynitrokey/pull/781

**Full Changelog**：https://github.com/Nitrokey/pynitrokey/compare/v0.12.3...v0.13.0
